# Givvly

> The right gift, for every right moment. Nigeria's modern events-first gifting and registry platform.

Givvly enables couples, celebrants, and event hosts to create bespoke digital invitations, manage multi-currency cash funds, collect group contributions, and curate physical gift wishlists with nationwide doorstep delivery.

## Core Capabilities

- **Digital Event Stationery**: Elegant event pages for Nigerian weddings (traditional & white), milestone birthdays, bridal showers, and send-forths. Supports love stories, schedule timelines, Aso-Ebi color palettes, RSVP tracking, and optional 4-digit PIN access locks. Optimized for sharing on WhatsApp and iMessage.
- **Cash Blessings & Group Pools**: Guests contribute monetary gifts in Naira or foreign currencies. Collective pools allow multiple guests to contribute towards large-ticket items such as honeymoons or home appliances.
- **Automated Bank Settlement**: All cash funds automatically settle to the host's verified Nigerian bank account every morning at 07:00 WAT (Africa/Lagos) via Paystack without manual withdrawal friction.
- **Diaspora Giving (UK, US, Canada, Europe)**: Real-time currency conversion previews in USD ($), GBP (£), and EUR (€). International guests pay via standard Visa/Mastercard, settled to the celebrant in NGN.
- **Curated Physical Gift Registry**: Luxury celebration hampers, artisanal homeware, and appliances from vetted Nigerian vendors, with custom gift-wrapping and nationwide doorstep delivery in Lagos, Abuja, and Port Harcourt.
- **Instant VTU Airtime & Mobile Data**: Direct digital connectivity gifts for MTN, Airtel, Glo, and 9mobile/T2Mobile.
- **Wall of Love**: Interactive digital guestbook where guests post heartfelt prayers, photos, and celebration messages, preserved forever as a commemorative keepsake.
